description: This file defines a Flutter widget named PopularProducts that displays a horizontally scrollable list of popular product cards in an e-commerce app. It imports necessary Flutter and project-specific components, and builds UI elements like a title and a list of product cards referencing a sample data list.

classes.name: PopularProducts
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of popular products in a horizontal scroll view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the PopularProducts widget, including a title and a horizontally scrollable list of product cards.
